[[Kolovish]], the former [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] of [[Kalikori village]], resided in an ancient '''stone tower''' atop the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] known as the [[Matriarch's Summit]] during her time on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].
